release_notes: Mandatory OPS 4.5.23 Task photo and Task progress correction. Saved and newly captured Task photos open in a full-screen zoomable viewer with mouse, double-click and mobile pinch controls. Save Progress, Complete Task, dirty close and background protection wait until UploadFile succeeds, D1 TaskPhoto is committed, and Task bootstrap reads the confirmed server record. Failed photos remain in their original tile with Retry/Delete and never permit a false Task save. TaskPhoto creates use stable IDs and do not enter the offline queue. The Worker Task action now sends only permitted progress fields so Staff and Leader saves no longer include legacy Task fields. No D1 migration, backfill, historical rewrite, physical deletion or runtime Sheet read is introduced.
